intro: Mo Zohourian turned rejected job applications into a $100-per-hour AI training career on LinkedIn, demonstrating one path into the growing field. Data center opposition across the US is emerging as a critical constraint on AI expansion, with investors flagging the backlash as a significant risk to the sector.
